# Goals

Heron has one goal so far, the chief information officer's first ask: a desk helper for Mac and Windows that sets up in two minutes and tells each person every morning what matters. It is a hunch with no measure yet. What the plan can promise depends on [[11-unknowns-and-risks#UNK-051 Text call|who settles whether meeting text may leave the laptop]], and nobody has settled that.
